title: Actual-LCM top-edge producer coordinates and punctured-staircase cost

concepts.label: actual-LCM top-edge residue gap
concepts.note: The one-sided terminal residue condition at a power-two endpoint.

concepts.label: punctured dyadic staircase
concepts.note: The conditional staircase route and its forced penultimate half-turn cost.

concepts.label: odd-guard half-word band supply
concepts.note: The guarded odd-depth half-word residue producer.

concepts.label: actual centered-magnitude supplies

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a J K m records m≤K, B<2^m, and the actual discrepancy residue at modulus 2^m is at most 2^m-B, where H=periodLcm(2^a) and B=2*H+J+K+2.
statement_nodes.engine: exact definition of the local one-sided terminal residue condition
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-internal reduction vocabulary; no historical priority or external novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The local predicate is not proved at cofinally many scales and is not itself an irrationality theorem.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Under the theorem's room hypotheses and an assumed actual-LCM terminal punctured dyadic staircase, the penultimate arithmetic letter is exactly 2^(m-1), and 2^m<2*B for the displayed terminal budget B.
statement_nodes.engine: exact terminal staircase recurrence and penultimate-letter arithmetic
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-internal route-pruning theorem; no historical priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem assumes a punctured staircase and constructs none. It fixes a first-scale cost and excludes an extra-bit version; it does not prove the local top-edge gap impossible.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PowerTwoActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGapSupply is the cofinal supply of power-two scales carrying the local actual-LCM top-edge residue gap.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-internal sufficient producer predicate; no historical priority or external novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The supply is not proved. Its existing irrationality consumer does not establish the antecedent.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PowerTwoAdjacentSuffixMidbandSupply is the cofinal two-sided adjacent-suffix midband producer, buffered so either adjacent depth remains in the sign corridor.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-internal sufficient producer predicate; no historical priority or external novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The supply is not proved, and its sufficiency does not make it necessary for nonintegrality.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PowerTwoOddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBandSupply is the cofinal guarded odd-depth half-word residue-band producer.
statement_nodes.engine: exact cofinal guarded half-word producer definition
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-internal sufficient producer predicate; no historical priority or external novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The supply is open. Finite bands do not discharge its cofinal quantifier.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PowerTwoActualFinalTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply is the canonical guarded cofinal lower bound on the absolute centered quantity actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q.
statement_nodes.engine: exact producer definition together with its proved equivalence to the odd-guard half-word supply
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-internal equivalent producer coordinate; no historical priority or external novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The predicate is not proved. Only this producer and the odd-guard half-word producer have a proved equivalence.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PowerTwoFlexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply asks for cofinally many flexible odd-rank room-and-fit scales at which the exact terminal carry corridor is escaped on at least one side.
statement_nodes.engine: exact flexible cofinal corridor-escape producer definition
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-internal sufficient producer predicate; no historical priority or external novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The supply is unproved and is sufficient, not proved necessary, for the existing nonintegrality endpoint.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PowerTwoFlexibleActualTerminalDominanceSupply is the stronger one-sided flexible producer requiring the displayed terminal dominance inequality d≤2*u at cofinally many room-and-fit scales.
statement_nodes.engine: exact flexible cofinal dominance producer definition
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-internal sufficient producer predicate; no historical priority or external novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The supply is not proved and is not refuted by the existing sign discussion.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PowerTwoFlexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply asks for cofinally many flexible odd-rank room-and-fit scales with the required centered actual top-edge magnitude.
statement_nodes.engine: exact flexible cofinal magnitude producer definition
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-internal sufficient producer predicate; no historical priority or external novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The supply is unproved. Its proved routes are one-way sufficient transports and do not establish strict inequivalence or necessity.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The cofinal producer quantifies the exact local top-edge residue-gap predicate.
The punctured route conditionally produces the local gap, while the theorem fixes its penultimate cost and rules out the extra-bit variant without disproving the gap itself.
